evidence.title: GitHub - emilkowalski/vaul: A drawer component for React.

name: Vaul
summary: Drawer component for React, published on npm as vaul, with a docs and demo site at vaul.emilkowal.ski.
description: Vaul is a drawer component for React (npm package vaul, MIT, 8.6k GitHub stars) for building slide-in panels and sheets; it depends on @radix-ui/react-dialog. The repo ships the component source, Playwright tests and a pnpm workspace, and the author marks it unmaintained; the docs site could not be reached during the crawl.
contains: Playwright tests and pnpm workspace in repo
repo marked unmaintained by the author
